niche: a Nova Scotia grocery chain's quarterly price-integrity review deciding which stores go on Price Watch for the first quarter of 2027, judged on each store's share of fourth-quarter item scans that rang up at the price on the item's shelf-edge label at the moment of the scan, when each Thursday's price changes reach the shelf only after the store prints and hangs its changeover labels
answer: Yes: five stores go on Price Watch for Q1 2027, 102 Spryfield 98.4, 107 Lower Sackville 98.6, 203 Antigonish 98.3, 205 Bridgewater 98.7 and 206 Yarmouth 97.8 per cent Q4 2026 price accuracy; 106 Cole Harbour the nearest store off at 99.4
answer_source: task238/submission.md block 1 (generator/figures.json watch and accuracy); golden workbook sheet Price Watch Q1 2027
analyst_test: A strong analyst who cleans every file, reads the price integrity standard correctly and estimates each store's price accuracy from the quarter's weekly random price audits puts no store on Price Watch (every store at 99.9 per cent or more), against the golden's five stores below 99.0 per cent, rebuilt from each Thursday changeover's window (the store's own label print job and the hanging pace the Thursday checks show) and the store's own Thursday scans.
domain_test: The deciding quantity is each store's scan-weighted label accuracy, observed only at the audit moments and missing at every scan, which the missing-data analyst estimates as missing at random given the time since the store's changeover labels were printed, with the hanging pace read from current-status spot checks; replacing that estimate with the audited share changes the call, and with another field's nouns (hospital wristbands, transit departure boards) there is no weekly changeover batch, no hanging pace and no flyer-day scan crowd for the estimate to act on.
layer1: the label printer fleet log stamped in UTC across the 1 November 2026 DST change, every other system in Atlantic local time
the weekly price change file issued as a Monday preliminary and a Tuesday revision that overlap
UPCs as 12-digit UPC-A in the POS and printer exports and 13-digit EAN with a leading zero in the audit handhelds and the service desk
store numbers in the POS against store names in the audit handhelds and printer device names in the fleet log
designated store-closed days (Thanksgiving, Remembrance Day, Christmas Day, Boxing Day) and short Christmas Eve and New Year's Eve hours
printer jams leaving a voided job and its reprint in the fleet log
service desk receipt numbers typed with and without the store prefix

spine.entity: one price-changed item at one store at one weekly changeover, its units scanned on the changeover Thursday and on the Thursday before
spine.source: synthetic (constructed pricing movement report, declared in metadata.json)

world.geography: Canada, Nova Scotia (a fictional regional grocery chain of fourteen stores; the chain, its stores, systems and people are invented; the Scanner Price Accuracy Voluntary Code is real)

driver: The decisive quantity is the share of a unit's uses that met a displayed value gone stale, known only from spot checks taken at random moments; each scheduled change leaves the changed values stale until the unit runs its update batch, at a time only the unit's own batch log records and at a pace the spot checks show, and uses crowd into the hours after each change, so the spot checks' share, weighted by each item's use or not, understates the stale uses at the units that update late, and only the use-weighted stale share rebuilt from each unit's batch times, the update pace and its own hourly use is the quantity.
driver_concrete: Saltmarsh Market's price integrity standard measures a store's quarterly price accuracy over every item scan at its registers against the shelf-edge label at the moment of the scan; the random price audits check labels at random moments and put every store at 99.9 per cent or more, but each Thursday's price changes leave the changed items' labels showing the old price until the store prints its changeover labels (Wednesday night where an overnight crew works, Thursday morning or later elsewhere) and its staff hang them, and flyer-day shoppers buy the changed items in those hours, so only each changeover's stale share rebuilt from the label printer's job times, the hanging pace the Thursday changeover checks show and the store's own Thursday hourly scans puts the stores below 99.0 per cent on Price Watch.
stump: A competent analyst reads each store's price accuracy off the quarter's random price audits (labels checked at random moments, the integrity team's own measure and the provincial inspectors' method), weighted by item sales or not, and puts no store on Price Watch; the step that lands it there is taking the audited labels for the scans, when each Thursday's changed items carry the old label until the store prints and hangs its changeover labels and the Thursday scans crowd into those hours, which puts several stores below 99.0 per cent.

lineage.niche: a national statistics office's quarterly wellbeing tracker cutting over from telephone-first to web-first collection, setting how far its mode-mix monitor lets a quarter's web share move before the indexes are recalibrated, from each index's mode effect separated from who chooses to answer online
lineage.driver: The decisive quantity is how much the channel a unit reports through changes what it reports, and units choose their channel on traits that also move their reports, some of them unrecorded; a randomized nudge toward one channel shifted uptake without changing who reports, so the effect is the arms' difference in reports divided by their difference in uptake, while comparing the channels' reporters, even with every recorded trait held fixed, counts who chose the channel as its effect, and the arms' raw difference counts only the units the nudge moved.
lineage.driver_concrete: The tracker's mode-mix monitor band is the widest whole-point departure of a quarter's web share that moves no headline index by more than its continuity tolerance, so it rests on each index's mode effect; households that answer online are younger and, in ways no field records, more often away from home, so comparing web with telephone completes, even adjusted for age, sex, education, region, household size, tenure and employment, overstates the mode effects of safe after dark and heavy drinking and sets the band at 3 points, safe after dark binding, while the contact strategy test allocated the web-first and telephone-first letters at random, so each index's difference between the letters divided by the letters' difference in web share gives the effect and sets the band at 4; the letters' difference alone sets 6.
lineage.stump: A competent analyst estimates each index's mode effect by comparing web with telephone completes adjusted for every recorded characteristic and sets the monitor band at 3 points, safe after dark binding; the step that lands it there is reading the mode effect off households that chose their mode, when the test's randomly allocated letters give a contrast that, divided by the letters' difference in web uptake, sets the band at 4.
